Query nvidia-smi, nvidia-smi -q, nvcc --version, and dpkg-query, check /dev/nvidia* permissions, and compare Driver Version, CUDA major version, VBIOS, required packages, and device-node access to yaml expectations. DCGM is not invoked

Compares the live NVIDIA CUDA stack against yaml expectations and emits one CSV row. kernel_version: expected uname -r prefix. nvidia_driver_version: substring of nvidia-smi Driver Version. cuda_version: CUDA major from nvidia-smi, falling back to nvcc --version. VBIOS must be present in nvidia-smi -q. required_packages: dpkg-query names. permissions_check: readable and writable /dev/nvidia* device nodes; directories such as /dev/nvidia-caps are skipped. DCGM is not invoked. output_format: csv
CSV with one row per CUDA stack check. A single row is duplicated to two samples
